figures.caption:
Figure 1. Overview of the Agentic AI ecosystem in remote sensing. The proposed framework consists of four key components: 1)
Foundations: Data acquisition and foundation models; 2) Agents: A classification of systems into single-agent copilots vs. multi-agent
orchestrators; 3) Systems: The technological stack (RAG, Tools, Memory) empowering the agents; and 4) Evaluation: Benchmarks for
assessing planning and reasoning capabilities. The figure also maps these components to specific Earth observation applications.
figures.name: figure-1-p001

figures.caption:
Table 1. Summary of remote sensing agents, covering taxonomy, applications, system design, and associated datasets and benchmarks
(SA/MA denote single/multi-agent).
figures.name: table-1-p005

figures.caption:
Figure 2.
Benchmarks and datasets for agentic remote sens-
ing AI. GeoRSMLLM [124] includes referring-expression tasks,
change detection, scene classification, and geo-localization; Om-
niGeo [120] covers health geography, RS scene classification, ur-
ban perception, and geospatial semantics; ThinkGeo [93] pairs RS
patches with multi-tool reasoning; and RingMo-Agent [45] sup-
ports multi-modal RS tasks such as relation reasoning, and VQA.
